gate_type: D-DAY TRACK B — FULL-FACTORY BASIC SIMULATION + AUTONOMOUS RUNTIME
objective: Turn the detailed Bottled Water Filling & Packaging demo into a small but coherent whole-factory simulation with a server-side autonomous runtime. Deliver: (a) server-side production clock independent of the browser, with START/PAUSE/RESUME/STOP/RESET semantics preserved; (b) aggregate basic simulation for Water Treatment, Bottle Preparation, Utilities and Warehouse/Dispatch around the unchanged detailed BW-FP line; (c) conservation/process consistency — water balance with a bounded tank, packaging-material balance, energy from power x time, causal utility response, FG balance; (d) a minimal FactoriX IIoT-ready asset taxonomy using the frozen B1 hierarchy; (e) one authoritative factory-level raw projection. No new engine, no KPI calculation, no B5/B6/B7 scope.
explicit_non_objectives: No second simulation engine, no fork of the discrete runtime
No new telemetry framework, scenario engine, protocol gateway, historian or persistence subsystem
No detailed process-physics engine (no membrane physics, no hydraulic solver)
OEE / availability / performance / quality% / energy-per-unit / utilization / health-score calculation
Manual quality / rework / release / checklist actions
A polished whole-factory VF overview UI (that belongs to PlantOS in B6)
Inventing FactoriX platform canonical IDs inside VF
A first-class PlantOS 'Line' entity (BW-FP stays an Area with role=production_line)
baseline_semantics_note: As for DDAY-B2/B3: the harness compares 'expected_base_sha' to origin/main and diffs it against HEAD, so it must be origin/main. 'sa_expected_baseline_sha' is the baseline issued in Issue #105 (the accepted DDAY-B3 head) and was verified equal to the branch head before the first B4 write.
allowed_paths_note: Entries from line_runtime.py onwards (including the B3 skin assets and prior evidence) are frozen DDAY-B1/B2/B2-C01/B3 artifacts already committed on this branch and therefore present in the diff against origin/main; they are listed only so the harness allowlist diff check is truthful and are NOT authorized for modification in B4. The B4-scope changed-file check against the B4 baseline 23b6208 in the evidence proves which files B4 actually touched.
sa_allowed_paths: a small Bottled Water workspace/domain composition module under src/virtual_factory/ if required
src/virtual_factory/assembly/demo_controller.py only for a bounded generic runner/control seam
src/virtual_factory/ui/static/bottled_water_demo.js plus minimal related skin changes needed to become observer-only
required_deliverables: configs/workspaces/bottled-water-dday/factory.yaml — aggregate-simulation parameters for the whole factory (rated loads, water balance, utility response, FG dispatch), with the hierarchy itself read from the frozen B1 topology.yaml (no duplication)

src/virtual_factory/workspaces/bottled_water.py (+ package init) — small Bottled Water domain composition: hierarchy/taxonomy from the B1 topology, aggregate Water Treatment / Bottle Preparation / Utilities / Warehouse models, and the factory-level raw projection. Composes the existing runtime; no second engine
src/virtual_factory/assembly/demo_controller.py — bounded generic runner/control seam for the autonomous server-side clock (only if required)
src/virtual_factory/ui/api.py — autonomous factory runner started with the app lifespan; factory-level projection endpoint; keeps the B3 target-line endpoints
src/virtual_factory/ui/static/bottled_water_demo.js — becomes observer-only: polls state, no longer POSTs /advance as the production clock
tests/test_dday_b4_*.py — tests covering all 21 required verifications
